style: Realistic cinematic look, rainy night, cool blue tones, film grain.

ning.description: Ning, a woman in her twenties with a long dark ponytail, beige trench coat, silver earrings.

shots.prompt: 0-2s: wide shot of an empty train station in the rain, Ning walks in. 2-4s: medium shot, she notices a phone glowing on a bench.
shots.caption: 11:58 p.m.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the phone screen lighting up, a voice message plays: "Don't get on the last train." Ning's face freezes.
shots.caption: "Don't get on the last train."

shots.prompt: 0-2s: the last train pulls in, brakes screeching. 2-4s: Ning steps back; through the door glass a woman identical to her stares back.
shots.caption: Who is she?
